queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff
FROM c;
WITH country_avg AS (
    SELECT birth_country, AVG(height) AS avg_height
    FROM player
    WHERE birth_country IS NOT NULL AND height IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY birth_country
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_height) AS mean_avg FROM country_avg
)
SELECT c.birth_country
FROM country_avg c, overall o
WHERE ABS(c.avg_height - o.mean_avg) > 0.1 * o.mean_avg;
SELECT p.player_id
FROM player p
WHERE p.player_id IN (
    SELECT player_id FROM player_award_vote
    UNION
    SELECT player_id FROM manager_award_vote
);
